MrlProjection.description: Where a projection-kind head's learned matrices live, and which matrix chain each ``k`` applies.

chains.description: ``k`` -> the tensor names applied in order, each a matrix ``(in_width, out_width)`` in the file, when the file's naming needs spelling out. ``None`` (the default) derives each ``k``'s chain from the declared dimensions: the tensors named for every declared dimension at or above ``k``, widest first -- the convention of a chained projection file whose tensor names are their target widths.
chains.title: Chains

source.description: The safetensors file holding the learned matrices: a storage URI (``hf://org/model@revision/projections.safetensors``, a ``gs://`` object, an ``https://`` URL) or a local path. The declared revision is part of the URI, so the bytes are immutable.
source.title: Source

MrlProjection.title: MrlProjection

description: A full-width embedding store's record: what is stored and the provenance of the vectors.

dataset.description: The dataset the corpus and queries were read from (its name, as the index records it).
dataset.title: Dataset

doc_ids.description: The corpus ids in stored row order.
doc_ids.title: Doc Ids

dtype.description: The stored dtype (``float32``, or ``float16`` for a late-interaction store in its transfer precision).
dtype.title: Dtype

full_width.description: The width of every stored vector -- the checkpoint's own output width, never a cut.
full_width.title: Full Width

identity.description: The store's content identity: the retrieval identity of the full-width encoder plus a full-width marker (rcp_ndcg.retrieval.build_store). ``k`` never enters it.
identity.title: Identity

layout.description: ``"single"`` (one vector per item) or ``"ragged"`` (late interaction: a flat token-vector buffer with offsets).
layout.title: Layout

max_tokens.description: The declared text budget (tokens), when declared.
max_tokens.title: Max Tokens

model.description: The served model name the vectors came from.
model.title: Model

mrl_dims.description: The declared set of supported output dimensions (``k`` values the sweep may select).
mrl_dims.title: Mrl Dims

mrl_projection.description: Where a projection kind's learned matrices live, when declared.

mrl_range.description: The declared closed range of output dimensions, when the card gives a range instead of a set; the sweep then needs explicit ``dims`` (a range cannot be enumerated).
mrl_range.title: Mrl Range

prompt_digest.description: The digest of the request-shaping fields (the prompts, the template, the budget and the shapes) that produced the vectors.
prompt_digest.title: Prompt Digest

query_ids.description: The query ids in stored row order.
query_ids.title: Query Ids

recipe.description: The serving recipe id, when the encoder declares one.
recipe.title: Recipe

revision.description: The checkpoint revision, when the encoder declares one.
revision.title: Revision

tokenizer.description: The tokenizer spec the text budget counted in, when declared.
tokenizer.title: Tokenizer

tokenizer_sha256.description: The tokenizer's content digest, when resolvable.
tokenizer_sha256.title: Tokenizer Sha256
